messages:
aris: heads-up: sudden spike of unassigned inbound leads for EMEA over the last 2.5h, looks like enrichment calls timing out on our side. noticed lots created from partners in DACH. ~360 unowned right now. @plum any quick fixes? :warning:
plum: thanks for flagging. do we know if this is HS enrichment or SF mapping?
aris: traces show enrichment svc returning 504 at ~1.8s for many. HS shows `enrichment_status = pending` then nothing. sample link: https://hub.internal/lead-samples/emea-burst (internal)
dave: short-term patch: 1) drop enrichment timeout from 10s -> 2s 2) enable fallback rr to `sdr-fallback-pool` for failed enrich 3) add rule to route `vip_priority` leads directly to `enterprise-routing` before enrichment. low-risk toggle.
plum: agree but need to be careful detecting VIP early. sometimes `vip_priority` is set after enrichment by partner webhooks. can we also check `lead_source == partner_enterprise` as a proxy?
tina: proposal: pre-check order -> if lead_source in (partner_enterprise, direct-sales) OR properties.company_revenue >= 5M -> immediate enterprise route; else attempt enrich(timeout=2s) -> on fail -> route to fallback RR. Also add a quick audit log write so we can sample misroutes.
plum: elastic. for observability: create metric `leads.unassigned.count` by region and `lead.assign.latency` histogram. set alert if unassigned_count > 200 or median assign > 90s for 30m window.
dave: pseudocode for HS workflow:
```
if lead_source in ('partner_enterprise','direct-sales') or properties.company_revenue >= 5000000:
  route('enterprise-queue')
else:
  do_enrich(timeout=2s)
  if enriched:
    map_and_assign()
  else:
    route('sdr-fallback-pool')
```
ops-bot: draft workflow `enrich-fallback-fastv2` created by dave at 2443301130. :white_check_mark:
plum: rollout steps: 1) apply workflow in staging 2) sanity test with 200 synthetic leads including VIPs 3) prod canary for EMEA only (3h) 4) monitor `unassigned` + `vip_misroute_rate` 5) rollback if vip_misroute_rate > 0.5% or median assign > 3m
aris: add constraint: fallback pool daily cap 150 leads to avoid overloading SDRs and a tag `fallback=true` on those routed leads. also capture a sample of rerouted VIPs to audit owners.
dave: deployed staging at 2443301145, running tests. will flip canary for EMEA if test pass. adding alert to #marketing-watch.
plum: scheduled post-deploy check at +45m after go. capture 1h and 24h probes.
ops-bot: workflow `enrich-fallback-fastv2` promoted to prod canary (EMEA) by dave at 2443301160. monitoring enabled.
aris: initial 20m numbers: unassigned down 360 -> 110, median assignment 24s, vip_misroute_count = 0. We'll keep the canary running and capture logs for the 3h window. thanks team.
